Unknown command: file-dialog-open
desktop — GUI automation tool (AT-SPI + xdotool)

Exit codes: 0=success, 1=not found, 2=timeout, 3=app fail, 4=AT-SPI fail

Explore:
  desktop apps [--json]                     List open applications
  desktop tree [--app NAME] [--depth N]     UI tree (default depth 2, 0=unlimited)
  desktop find "query" [--role R] [--app N] Find elements by name
  desktop active                            Active window info
  desktop screenshot [path]                 Capture screen
  desktop locate-image --screenshot S --template T [--json]
                                            Deterministic local template localization
  desktop click-image --screenshot S --template T --allow-coordinate
                                            Click visual match center (coordinate-gated)
  desktop snapshot [path] [--json]          Screenshot + tree/observation
  desktop observe [--json] [--screenshot P] Structured screenshot + AT-SPI observation
  desktop selftest                          Check AT-SPI/xdotool/DISPLAY/D-Bus
  desktop verify --text TEXT [--timeout N]  Verify text/active/file predicates
  desktop verify --human-check              Stop if CAPTCHA/human-verification is visible

Interact:
  desktop click "element" [--nth N] [--app NAME] [--role R] [--allow-coordinate]
  desktop dblclick "element" [--app NAME] [--role R] [--allow-coordinate]
  desktop rclick "element" [--app NAME] [--role R] [--allow-coordinate]
  desktop type "text" [--into "field"] [--clear] [--verify-input]
                                            Type with human-paced timing (logged masked)
  desktop key ctrl+s                        Press key combination
  desktop select "File > Save"              Navigate menu path
  desktop focus "window"                    Focus + confirm title
  desktop scroll up|down [N]
  desktop read "element" [--app NAME]       Read element text
  desktop table "element" [--json]          Read table data

Apps:
  desktop open browser URL                  (auto: --force-renderer-accessibility)
  desktop open vscode /path                 (auto: accessibility.support=on)
  desktop open terminal [cmd]
  desktop open file /path
  desktop close [--app NAME] [--force]      Close windows; force kills process only with --force

Power:
  desktop chain "cmd1" "cmd2" [--continue-on-error]
  desktop wait "element" [--timeout N] [--gone]
  desktop run-task spec.json [--record DIR] Execute recorded observe/action/verify spec

Macros:
  desktop macro list|save|run <name> [commands...]
